title: Bots and/or an addon is ruining the AH

posts.cooked: It’s so obvious it’s one of the two, put up a single count of something undercutting by ~30-40% and then buyout anything posted for the same price at inhuman speeds. You cannot physically react fast enough to buyout items that are put up that aren’t the bots’/addon user. Something really needs to be done about this, it’s completely tanking the economy.
